deletion_authority: explicit experiment-owner direction on 2026-09-04 ("delete failed records")
rule: Weighted token cost is defined across the complete persistent workflow, and interrupted execution with incomplete provider usage is a named invalidity condition. None of these is a replicate dropped for the number it produced: each was truncated by an account limit external to the treatment, so there was no complete trajectory to price.
distinction_from_the_apparatus_defect_po: The 2026-08-30 slot policy in AGENTS.md is about runs whose declared treatment was not operating. That is not what happened here: every treatment was installed, and in the Cartog case the MCP server was connected with its tools registered before the provider cut the session off. These are provider interruptions, which is why the deletion needed explicit owner direction rather than following automatically. The effect on slots is the same -- an invalid run does not keep a replicate index.

None of them had a published comparison, which is correct: the runner had already marked all three operationally-invalid and excluded them from token accounting on its own.
